title: The 3 AM Outage (DEV SAMPLE)
subtitle: Checkout is down, the pager is screaming, and nobody deployed anything. Or did they?

inspiredBy.title: Sample real-world outage
inspiredBy.summary: A placeholder summary of the real incident this case is modeled on.

briefing:
## You are on call

It is **03:07** and the pager just fired: `checkout-service 5xx > 20%`.

- Find when it started
- Find what changed
- Find why it kept failing

> This is dev sample content.
rules: Every answer can be derived from the evidence.
Hints cost points; wrong answers are free.
No answers in the page source. Don't bother.
